verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same flaw: the full-bleed pizza photo with the orange band across it has been turned into a plain white page. The full-width band sits on top of a small inset photo with ~22px side margins that don't line up with the band, and there is a large blank white area at the bottom, so the original's bold immersive feel is lost. A is worse because the stack sits high (~63px gap at the top versus ~160px of empty white at the bottom). B is more evenly centred (~97px top, ~125px bottom), but it still leaves dead space and has the same mismatched edges.
